messages:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT: sustained p99 latency spike detected for tenant QuasarAnalytics in eu-west-3 dedicated pool dp-4387. Rule: p99 > 1.5s for 5m. Affected route: /v1/generate (model: gpt-redwood-13b-8bit, tenant: quasar-123). Detected at 1798765432.

oncall-joe: I'm paged. taking lead. tagging @sre-amy @eng-runtime-miguel. starting quick triage.

sre-amy: looking at traces now. p95 ~300ms, p99 ~2.4s. spike correlates with requests >1024 tokens. KV cache miss rate for quasar-123 jumped to 72% in last 3m.

eng-runtime-miguel: likely KV cache thrash + hot-shard on dp-4387. Two immediate options: isolate tenant to a warmed slice, or scale pool. isolation is faster to reduce cross-tenant interference. I can trigger route override to pool-warm-12.

infra-ops-bot: Autoscale suggestion computed: +2 GPUs on dp-4387 would lower avg token latency estimate by ~25%. Estimated boot/warm time ~90s. (suggestion id: as-881)

oncall-joe: miguel — do route override. amy — prepare isolation slice and prefill cache. lina — prep customer comms.

sre-amy: isolation is safe. I'll create a tenant slice and prefill with typical prompts. blocking other tenants from that slice. prepping preload job.

eng-runtime-miguel: running route override now:
```bash
# route override for tenant quasar-123 to warmed slice
redwoodctl route override --tenant quasar-123 --pool pool-warm-12 --until +20m --reason "latency spike mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: route override accepted (change-id r-9921). rolling to edge proxies.

oncall-joe: override applied. monitoring.

sre-amy: starting preload job j-773 to seed KV cache (prompts sample set size 250).

eng-runtime-miguel: preload job j-773 logs: KV hits climbing from 18% -> 56% after first 30s.

oncall-joe: p99 trending down — 60s after action p99 = 1.1s. p95 = 280ms. still above SLA but improving.

acct-exec-lina: I just messaged Quasar CSM with a short note: "We're seeing elevated latencies for some long-context requests. We've applied a temporary routing isolation and are scaling warm capacity. Will update in 10m." They asked to be on a short bridge.

customer-bridge-bot: QuasarAnalytics (Jen) acknowledged and joining channel.

QuasarRep-Jen: Thanks team — our dashboards show user-facing queueing. Any ETA on mitigation?

oncall-joe: ETA 10m to confirm stable. primary mitigation: isolation + prefill; fallback: add 2 GPUs to dp-4387 (infra suggestion).

sre-amy: current metrics: p99 = 0.95s, p95 = 220ms, KV cache hit rate = 72% for quasar-123 on pool-warm-12. We should keep route override until hit rate >80% and p99 <0.85s for 3 consecutive 1m windows.

eng-runtime-miguel: prepping rollback plan if something regresses. revert command below:
```bash
# revert route override
redwoodctl route revert --change r-9921 --confirm
```

oncall-joe: good. infra-ops-bot — if we see another spike after we remove override, plan to autoscale per as-881 automatically.

infra-ops-bot: autoscale policy as-881 armed for dp-4387 (threshold p99 > 1.5s sustained 2m). Will execute if triggered.

oncall-joe: handoff note — I will remain the active responder for 30m, then hand off to @infra-katie for the night. documenting actions: route override r-9921, preload j-773, monitor p99 and cache hit.

sre-amy: stabilization check at +10m: p99 = 0.78s, p95 = 210ms, KV hit rate 84%. No errors or increased error budget usage.

QuasarRep-Jen: Seeing recovery on our side too. Thanks for fast action. Please keep us posted on RCA/next steps.

oncall-joe: quick postmortem steps: (1) keep override until we see stable metrics for 1hr, (2) schedule RCA to investigate why prefill was necessary — likely session affinity or model context fragmentation, (3) discuss model/quantization recommendations for long-context workloads with Quasar.

acct-exec-lina: I'll schedule customer follow-up call and loop product for recommendations.

infra-katie: I'll take handoff at +30m. please add any notes I should know.

oncall-joe: notes for handoff: r-9921 applied, j-773 completed, current p99 0.78s, KV hit 84%, autoscale armed as-881. If p99 creeps >1.2s re-run preload and/or execute as-881.

sre-amy: creating incident ticket INC-2026-0049 with timeline and links to traces + flamegraphs. RCA owners: eng-runtime + infra.

oncall-joe: wrap-up: mitigation successful; customer on bridge; handoff planned. :thumbsup:

QuasarRep-Jen: Appreciate the quick response. We'll monitor and await RCA.

oncall-joe: closing active war-room. will update ticket with action items and next steps.
